summary: The term "مِنْ لَدُنْ" (min ladun) means "from the time of" or "from the presence of.
lane: مِنْ لَدُنْ ذ From the time of: see a verse cited in art. عى , conj. 4. -b2- هٰذَا الأَمْرُ مِنْ لَدُنْهُ i. q. مِنْ قِبَلِهِ , q. v. (Lth in TA, in art. قبل .)

headwords.def: Supple; lithe; limber; limp; pliant; pliable; flexible.
مِنْ لَدُنْ From the time of: see a verse cited in art. عى, conj. 4. هٰ َا الأَمْرُ مِنْ لَدُنْهُ i. q. مِنْ قِبَلِهِ, q. v. (Lth in TA, in art. قبل.)

headword_note: Lane organises by verb form and principal noun, not by every inflected form. A word with no headword entry falls back to the root meaning; nothing is inferred.
